reviews.x: As a professional barber I was looking forward to another good blade to last me at lease 3 months till have to buy another one this blade did not last me even a 2 weeks it's leaving longer hairs, the blade got dull to quick this products sucked y'all got me this time not again tho.

reviews.t: These blades are amazing, they’re sharp and cut very smooth
reviews.x: I have had my wahl 5 star seniors for over 4 years and they recently are not cutting properly and noticed haircuts are not as crispy. I was about to buy new clippers but I came across some reviews online saying that replacing the actual blades would make my clippers work like new again. I have to say that these blades are amazing, they’re sharp and smooth and might be better than when my clippers were new. I would definitely recommend!

reviews.t: Crazy If You Don't Buy Them
reviews.x: The Gist of it: This replacement blade set (2-hole) revitalized my Wahl adjustable clippers purchased at a certain big chain box store back in 2000. Definitely worth the cost, as opposed to buying an entire new clipper set. As other customers have noted, it does take a bit of patience to align the blades and keep them that way while tightening the screws. However, it is far from rocket science. As at least one other customer noted, I also had to use my old screws as the new ones would not thread
I'm a stylist and my 5 stars came with a two hole blade. When going to Sallys I was given a 3 hole. This blade is accurate..unopened and sharp.
Good blade for fading. Replaced stock blade on my cordless Wahl Magic Clips with this blade. Changed the whole dynamic of the clipper!

The blade on my cheaper set of wahl clippers became dull ( the precision marked ones), so I decided to replace them with the ones found on the wahl seniors. Comes with oil, screws and two well lubed blades (stationary blade, and moving blade). I did however used my older screws because the ones that came with theses weren't wide enough.  These blades love to grab a hold of hair, and cut it off. I noticed the difference in the cut quite easily. I actually think they are a lot better then the one

reviews.t: Alternate blade for the Wahl 9590-210 Pro-series Clipper with rechargeable battery
reviews.x: I bought this replacement set to replace the blade that came in the Wahl 9590-210 Pro-series Complete Pet Clipper Kit (Cordless Operation, Blue) that I bought a few years ago. The original blade worked well for a few years, but after giving a new summer hair style to one of the cats, it dulled the blade and this year it was painfully slow to trim the cat's hair again. For all the "will this fit questions" (because I was curious too), I took a few photos of measurements. If you use larger screws, be sure to keep them so you can attach these blades.  The holes are about 24 mm apart on center and about 6.5 mm in diameter. The included screws are about 3.8 mm in diameter. The ones my clipper needs are about 4.8 mm in diameter. In principle I prefer products designed to be repaired. These blades were a perfect replacement to get years of use more out of my clippers. The enclosed screws inexplicably did not fit my clippers, but I was able to reuse the original screws. No more hair tugging.

My magic clip was making a weird noise so I bought these new blades and it worked! No more weird noise. But It’s different than the original blade. I haven’t tried it yet. Hopefully it works the same.

I dropped accidentally my clipper, and the tips of the blades were broken. I replaced them with these, and you can notice the difference, they're really sharp. They came in a sealed container with an small amount of clipper's oil and two screws.
They sound horrible. I have oiled them up several times and the noice is awful. I’m not sure these are real wahl clipper blades.
Perfect replacement blade for my WAHL magic clip! Authentic!

reviews.t: Sharp and ready to be oiled and put use use.
reviews.x: These blades are really sharp and give a clean cut with my clippers. I use an off brand clipper, and these blades fit perfect, and worked right away. I have not used them over a long period yet, but from previous experience professional blades stay sharp a long time with home use. Full disclosure I am not a  licensed stylist or barber, I am simply the designated one in my household, also friends and other family members.

reviews.t: Wrong blades for my trimmer. Not worth the aggravation ...
reviews.x: Wrong blades for my trimmer. Not worth the aggravation of returning. Apparently there are more than one set of blades with this "part number" - either that or Wahl can't be bothered to stamp a part number on their blades so one can definitively locate the correct replacement parts. I will probably not buy another Wahl product again because of this issue.

I have purchased these replacement blades many times before for my 6 year old 5 star senior. This last set does not fit - the screws are too large and the holes are too big. I was able to use the inner blade but not the bottom blade. Beware if you have an older model 5 star senior.

reviews.t: Turned my clipper brand new and even sharper than new
reviews.x: I had ordered a new clipper but after checking the review of this blade, I cancelled my order But after I received and installed this new blade, it turned my clipper brand new and even sharper than when it was first purchased. I am happy about this order

reviews.t: Great clippers and this replacement blade brought it back to ...
reviews.x: I have a set of Wahl clippers that I use to buzz my own hair. Great clippers and this replacement blade brought it back to like new performance.
I have twelve years of experience with haircutting, and this blade works very well with my clippers. I even bought 22 of them in total.
This was an OEM Part, so I had no doubt that I would be satisfied.  Easy to replace, fast shipping, and back to shaving my own head.
Blade seems wider than original, so had to adjust a few times.  When lever is used in larger position, it cuts less than before.
This clipper is sharp I cut my sons hair and he said it hurts and I tried it and it gave me and him a mark

claims.text: Most reviewers find these blades sharp and effective, often restoring clippers to like-new performance.
Many customers successfully use these as replacements to extend the life of their existing clippers rather than buying new ones.
Several reviewers note the included screws may not fit and recommend reusing the original screws.
A few reviewers complain the blades dulled quickly or made horrible noises, questioning authenticity.
Some reviewers warn to research fit carefully before buying, citing difficulty identifying compatibility and no returns.
